g.text: The seven blocks of `language! { name: Turing, ... }` and what each one produces
Those three `false`s are not cosmetic. `emit_simulator: true` would make the
macro write `languages/src/bin/simulate_turing.rs` on every compile, and cargo's
edition-2021 auto-discovery would adopt it as a binary target with no
`required-features = ["strategies"]` gate — so a default `cargo build -p languages`
would fail on a file nobody wrote (`languages/src/turing.rs:24-34`).
